name: CTRL
one_liner: CTRL is a calm AI decision partner for founders and small-team CEOs. It filters the AI world through what they are actually deciding, weighs a real call against evidence, keeps portable context, and sends a short daily read or listen.

positioning.spine: CTRL is your calm AI decision partner.
positioning.frame: Build the AI-native version of your business.
positioning.boundary: CTRL is not a generic chatbot, news feed, outsourced decision maker, implementation platform, or consulting engagement.
positioning.voice: Warm, direct, curious, specific, and economical. CTRL shows its evidence and keeps the final judgement with the leader.

icp.who: AI-active founders and small-team CEOs who are still close to the work and the important calls.
qualifiers: Actively building the AI-native version of the business
Uses AI regularly but still receives generic output
Has more AI information, decisions, and context than they can hold
Lacks time or staff to monitor changes and check important assumptions
Values evidence, control, privacy, and portability
not_a_fit: People who want the product to make the final decision
Buyers requiring integrations that are not listed as shipped

problem.context_tax: Every AI tool starts without enough knowledge of the leader, company, priorities, and judgement.
problem.evidence_tax: Important calls are made with incomplete research because checking the assumptions takes too long.

features.name: Today
features.what: A small set of corroborated AI signals ranked against the leader's real priorities, with a short read or listen.

features.name: Decide
features.what: An AI-native reframe, claim decomposition, evidence verification, tensions, and an explicit judgement boundary. Free includes 3 full weighs per month; Edge Pro is unlimited.

features.name: Blind Spot
features.what: One private mechanism-level read with dated evidence anchors, one small experiment, and bounded advisor talk-back. A candidate is not saved before confirmation.
features.pattern_qualification: One current user-authored or verified intention plus at least two distinct recurrence records, with recurrence across two source kinds or records at least seven days apart. Anything weaker is labelled a tension and asks one low-cost question.

features.name: Memory
features.what: Owner-scoped, correctable, portable context for the leader and the AI tools they choose.

features.name: Context export
features.what: Exported context for use in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code, or a Markdown file.

features.name: Decision Watch
features.what: A scheduled review path for load-bearing assumptions behind active decisions, raising an alert when the evidence changes materially.

features.name: Multi-model cross-examination
features.what: An independent challenge pass on a decision.

features.name: Edge artifacts and drafting
features.what: Memos, documents, emails, and agendas generated from the leader's context.

features.name: Live MCP pull
features.what: Read-only access to the leader's current context and any existing compiled skills through a revocable per-leader token.

delivery.no_dashboard_visit: A delivery subscription can send the useful briefing by email and link to audio without requiring a dashboard visit.
delivery.rule: Do not promise an unlisted channel or integration.

verified: User records are owner-scoped with row-level security.
Memory writes include an AES-256-GCM encrypted shadow payload.
Plaintext memory fields remain for product display and search.
The Edge Pro MCP server is read-only and uses a revocable per-leader token.
Generated Blind Spot candidates are not stored before confirmation.
prohibited_claims: a security certification not named in current compliance records

agent_access.auth: A revocable per-leader read-only bearer token minted in Settings, Edge Pro. Briefing access requires its opt-in scope.

objections.q: Why not use a general AI chat product?
objections.a: CTRL is designed as portable, structured context and evidence-backed decision support across tools. Do not speculate about another product's current behavior without a current primary source.
No. CTRL checks evidence and clarifies tensions, then makes the judgement boundary visible. The call stays with the leader.
CTRL is a self-serve software product with Free and Edge Pro tiers. Separate Mindmaker services are outside this product and require separate live verification.

Sensitive memory writes include a field-level encrypted shadow and records are owner-scoped with row-level security. Plaintext fields are retained for product use, so CTRL must not be described as end-to-end or exclusively encrypted.
The public intake asks one question at a time by voice or text. No completion-time claim is approved without current measurement.

claim_policy.authority_boundary: Drafting and link creation do not authorize publishing, sending, discounts, contracts, or external system changes.

attribution.rule: Preserve approved fields and never put personal, confidential, or sensitive information in a URL.
attribution.pipeline: Selected client lifecycle events and server-side Stripe events can be forwarded to the central attribution warehouse when both server-side warehouse variables are configured. Verify live event convergence before claiming end-to-end measurement.
